title: Nonhuman senses and UI: all sensory paths, spatial execution and stable event identity
head: b6678ea9ba4a7cf0313ce83e0c0fc6b0e5c26d5b

reviews.classification: Full UI/perception proposal; source projections and future browser gates qualified
reviews.disposition:
F1. Complete read covers SF1–SF6, seven sensory palettes, scale/cargo/reach cases, six surface homes, both viewport compositions, naming/token/accessibility sections, five first-minute beats, SU1–SU17, N1–N15 joins and SS1–SS5. The Oct19 namespace preamble says SU1–SU15, but the body actually extends through SU17; retain the owner qualifier without treating the shortened preamble as complete coverage. All these rows are proposals/source seams, not implemented sensory UI. Existing title filtering does not prove component tooltips, combat labels, search, hidden DOM and accessible names are qualified too.

F2. Perception, identification, memory, report, estimate, measurement, dialogue eligibility and action admission remain distinct. A render projects actual evidence rather than sampling a fresh scan, spreading knowledge or triggering another hazardous observation. A genuine world-specific harmful-observation event can settle once while captions/repaint/reload of the same result do not create new exposure. Strong sensing, remote action, perfect recognition or shared cognition may work through their real source; ordinary smell/echo examples do not set universal limits under AD38. Losing sight/link support stops unsupported live claims without deleting honestly retained knowledge or fictional-body-independent player controls.

F3. Scale is actual route geometry, material/method, load/volume, balance, storage and cargo custody, not CSS zoom or a universal combat multiplier. Preview can become stale after growth, changed load, door/weather or carrier departure; favorite/quick-return/combat-exit paths need the same actual movement semantics. Shrinking does not silently shrink stock, a map memory is not a usable route, and sensed/physically reachable/controllable targets remain separate. Advice/request, accepted carrying and actual transit settle different operations. Rebinding the display seat does not move items, transfer mastery, heal a body or establish acting authority.

F4. Keep current task, quote/blocker/commit/return and useful independent context together. Body replaces irrelevant humanoid-slot detail only where appropriate; it does not add every colony/host/reach panel to every life. The column arithmetic and roughly16px samples are unmeasured historic budgets, not evidence of populated desktop fit. Current desktop1920×1080/Mac context and actual14/21px, prose-first independent panes and optional art qualify the old1366-primary and forced-layout examples. A useful spatial target list can work without a map graphic, permanent sonar or compulsory motion/color puzzle. Text enlargement/accessibility does not create a mobile-optimization prerequisite.

F5. Preserve actual event actor/speaker/observer when rendering legacy name tokens; later seat switch/rename must not rewrite an old event's referent. Normalize age aliases at the actual biography/translation seam rather than global prose replacement. Historical middle-aged/neutral-greeting and token-route findings were not freshly reproduced or fixed here. Name/pronoun/body-stage/collective/title distinctions and escaping at HTML boundaries remain useful selected-consumer checks. A first-minute teaching overlay uses the ordinary controls, actual attention time and admitted faculty without forced failure, manufactured ignorance or a new reward on reload. SS1–SS5 name future evidence rather than passed browser journeys; AD36/AD43 assign relevant stages and AD42 keeps human pacing/taste review optional. Under AD32 the proposed fields, surfaces and sequence remain proposals; no code, primary source, rebuilt UI, accessibility, persistence or controller implementation was newly verified.
reviews.evidence: Entire404-line input delivered in ranges1–140,141–275,276–404. No linked runtime, dossier or browser evidence renewed.
reviews.reopen: Selected perception/body/route/name consumer changes; check all rendered paths and actual mutation/settlement using current desktop authority, rather than adding all proposed panels.
